title: Driver support service
titleCn: 道路救援服务电话登记：拖车与车辆信息

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text:
friend of mine recommended your service.

00:00:06,120

I'm in need of assistance.

00:00:08,400

My friend mentioned that you have tow trucks capable of safely pulling cars.

00:00:13,200

Nice to meet you, John.

00:00:15,580

Before we proceed, we'll need your contact details to fill out our service form and dispatch our staff.

00:00:22,180

Sure. I live at one sixteen Charlecote Road in Salisbury.

00:00:27,560

C-H-A-R-L-E-C-O-T-E.

00:00:30,920

Thank you for providing your address, John.

00:00:33,960

This will help us keep your information up to date. Could you also provide me with your postcode so that we can send you detailed service information via mail?

00:00:43,000

My postcode is SE13AL.

00:00:46,040

Perfect. We have that noted down. Now, could you please let me know the make of your car?

00:00:52,269

This will help us send mechanics with relevant experience.

00:00:56,440

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
bought it last year.

00:01:00,760

It's brand new.

00:01:02,440

Great. We have that information on file now.

00:01:05,860

Lastly, could you please provide me with the registration number of your car? This will make it easier for us to locate your vehicle.

00:01:13,980

The registration number is S232TAT.

00:01:18,240

Thank you. It's been noted down. If it's helpful, could you also tell us the color of your car?

00:01:24,830

The car was originally red, but my wife recently painted it green.

00:01:29,100

Thank you for sharing that detail, John. It will definitely help with vehicle identification.

00:01:35,620

Now, could you please briefly explain what happened?

00:01:39,240

It's possible that my vehicle is running low on oil.

00:01:42,960

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
only realized it after I began driving on the motorway and couldn't find a gas station. That's when I decided to exit the motorway.

00:01:51,780

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
see.

00:01:53,240

We'll make sure to bring some fuel. Please continue.

00:01:57,260

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
wasn't familiar with the road conditions, and when I was searching for a station to refuel my car, I got it stuck in the mud.

00:02:04,440

I'm sorry to hear that.

00:02:06,540

Are you currently in a safe location?

00:02:09,400

Yes, I'm near a bridge. I spotted a road sign around one hundred meters away indicating that it's Albany Road.

00:02:17,040

All right. Let's organize assistance for you.

00:02:20,260

Is there any urgency?

00:02:22,120

Yes. My mother has a back injury and is unable to move.

00:02:26,380

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
wanted to call an ambulance, but she refused. She believes she will recover soon.

00:02:32,780

I'm sorry to hear about your mother's condition. Let me dispatch help right away. Given the distance, it will take our mechanics approximately 40 minutes to reach your location.

00:02:44,560

Thank you. Although it's quite a distance.

00:02:47,600

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
can't spot any convenience stores nearby, and the wind is really strong today.

00:02:52,560

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
understand. Please make sure your mother is comfortable.

00:02:57,240

My suggestion is to find a warm place where you can take care of her. Your mother's well-being is our top priority.

00:03:04,800

Thank you for your understanding and prompt response. I really appreciate your support.

00:03:11,280

I'll keep you informed of any updates or changes.
